notes: Account summary: mid-market analytics SaaS building in-app product assistants + search. Evaluating Redwood hosted API first for quick time-to-value; roadmap expects Dedicated if EU residency SLA and better unit economics proven.

Latency/throughput targets: EU interactive chat p95 <= 120ms (goal 80-100ms in region), peak embeddings throughput ~400-600 req/s during batch indexing windows, tail latency concerns for long context renders.

Data residency requirement: EU-only storage + processing for user content; legal insists on data never leaving EU for EU customers. Will consider multi-region routing for global users but EU-origin data must remain in EU. Explicit ask: contractual clause + technical proof (region-specific logs).
